full-time-maid.name: Full-time housemaid
full-time-maid.summary: A live-in housemaid for daily household work, with the contract and visa handled end to end.
highlights: Profile and interview before you choose
full-time-maid.description: We help families in Qatar choose a live-in housemaid who fits the size of the home and the household routine. You receive candidate profiles with experience and spoken languages, we arrange the interview, and we then handle the contract, visa and medical steps so she starts work properly documented.
full-time-maid.idealFor: Families who need continuous daily help at home.

part-time-cleaning.name: Part-time cleaning
part-time-cleaning.summary: Cleaners by the hour or on a weekly schedule, with no long-term commitment.
part-time-cleaning.description: Suited to apartments and villas that need regular cleaning without a live-in maid. You set the hours and days, and we send the same team wherever possible so they learn your home and keep the standard consistent on every visit.
part-time-cleaning.idealFor: Apartments, smaller households and anyone who only needs periodic cleaning.

deep-cleaning.name: Deep cleaning
deep-cleaning.summary: A thorough clean before moving in or after renovation, using specialist equipment.
highlights: Kitchen and bathrooms cleaned in depth
Steam cleaning for sofas and carpets
Ideal before or after a move
deep-cleaning.description: A top-to-bottom clean that reaches what day-to-day cleaning does not: inside cupboards, behind appliances, air-conditioning vents, kitchen grease, and steam cleaning for upholstery. The team completes it in a single visit against a clear checklist.
deep-cleaning.idealFor: New homes, property handovers and post-maintenance cleaning.

nanny.name: Nanny and childcare
nanny.summary: Experienced nannies who care for children and keep their daily routine.
nanny.description: We shortlist nannies with practical experience across age groups, from infants to school age. You see each candidate's experience and spoken languages and can interview her yourself before deciding whether she suits your family.
includes: School drop-off and pick-up if agreed
nanny.idealFor: Working families who need dependable childcare.

elderly-care.name: Elderly care
elderly-care.summary: Companionship and in-home support for older family members, with respect for your privacy.
elderly-care.description: In-home support that helps older people stay safely at home: help with mobility and personal hygiene, medication reminders, suitable meals and daily companionship. This is non-medical care and we say so before any agreement; if the situation needs qualified nursing, we tell you.
includes: Help with mobility and personal hygiene
elderly-care.idealFor: Families arranging in-home care for their parents.

cooking.name: Home cooking
cooking.summary: Daily home-cooked meals prepared the way your family likes them.
cooking.description: A cook or kitchen-experienced helper who prepares daily meals to your family's taste, including batch cooking for several days at a time. Food allergies, special diets and halal requirements are taken into account.
cooking.idealFor: Busy households and anyone who wants regular home-cooked meals.

faq.title: Questions we are asked often

items.question: What is the difference between a full-time maid and part-time cleaning?
items.answer: A full-time maid lives in the home and handles daily work under a long-term contract. Part-time cleaning is booked as individual visits when you need them, with no long commitment.

items.question: Do you handle the contract and the visa?
items.answer: Yes. For full-time placements we handle the contract, visa and medical steps in line with the regulations in force in Qatar, and we tell you upfront which documents we need from you.

items.question: How long does it take before work starts?
items.answer: It depends on the service, candidate availability and the official formalities. Send us your request and we will give you a realistic timeline for your case.

items.question: Can the worker be replaced if she is not the right fit?
items.answer: Yes. The replacement policy and its conditions are set out in the contract before signing, so both sides know where they stand.

items.question: Which areas do you cover?
items.answer: We serve Doha and the surrounding areas across Qatar. Tell us your area and we will confirm whether it is covered.

items.question: How does pricing and payment work?
items.answer: We explain the cost and what it covers before you agree to anything. Prices depend on the service and the hours involved, and you can ask for a quote on WhatsApp.

aboutPage.title: A domestic services agency that works transparently with families in Qatar
aboutPage.description: We help households find someone they can rely on at home, and we explain every step and cost before anything is agreed.
aboutPage.metaDescription: How we work to provide domestic staff and home services in Qatar: a clear choice, proper paperwork, and follow-up after the work starts.
story: We work between families in Qatar and the people who provide domestic help. Our job is to save you the searching and comparing: we listen to what you need, shortlist the people who fit it, and handle the official steps so the work starts properly documented.

Hiring someone into your home is a decision that belongs to the family, so we do not push to close an agreement and we do not send more candidates than you asked for. We tell you what we know about each candidate, and what we do not, and leave the decision to you after the interview.

clarity.title: Clarity before agreement
clarity.description: You know the cost, what it covers and how long the formalities take before any financial commitment.

legal.title: Following the rules
legal.description: Contracts and procedures in line with the regulations in force in Qatar, with clear rights on both sides.

respect.title: Respect both ways
respect.description: We treat workers the way we treat families: written terms and mutual respect.

support.title: Follow-up after the start
support.description: We stay in touch once work has begun so any issue is dealt with while it is still small.

aboutPage.areasDescription: We cover Doha and the surrounding areas. If your area is not listed, ask us and we will confirm whether it is covered.

howItWorksPage.title: The process from your first message to the first day of work
howItWorksPage.description: This is how we actually work, and what we need from you at each stage.
howItWorksPage.metaDescription: The steps for hiring domestic help in Qatar: your request, the options, the interview, the contract and formalities, then follow-up after work starts.

steps.title: Send us your request
steps.description: The easiest route is a WhatsApp message with the service you need, your area, and the hours or working days you have in mind. You can also call during working hours.
steps.need: What we need from you: the service, your area, and a good time to reach you.

steps.title: We explain the options and the cost
steps.description: A few short questions about the size of the home, the household and the tasks involved, then the available options with what each one costs and covers.
steps.need: What we need from you: details of the home and the expected tasks.

steps.title: You review candidates and interview
steps.description: We send the profiles that fit, with experience and spoken languages, and you choose who to interview. The interview happens before any commitment.
steps.need: What we need from you: a time for the interview and your decision.

steps.title: Contract and formalities
steps.description: Once you have chosen, we prepare the contract and complete the required steps such as the visa and medical check, depending on the type of placement, and tell you which documents we need.
steps.need: What we need from you: the official documents required for the contract.

steps.title: Work starts, and we follow up
steps.description: In the first weeks we check in to make sure things are going as agreed and to deal with any issue early.
steps.need: What we need from you: honest feedback, early.

documents: A copy of the applicant's ID

howItWorksPage.timingDescription: It depends on the service, candidate availability and the official formalities. Cleaning by the hour can be arranged quickly, while a full-time placement needs time for the contract and visa. We give you an estimate for your case at first contact.
